en: First Collection, Chapter on the Leaf Please note: The term "Littavagga" appears to be a typographical error for "Pattavagga" (the Chapter on the Leaf). I have translated it accordingly. If you require a different interpretation, please provide the corrected source text.
"Do not trust one who is untrustworthy, nor trust even one who is trustworthy."
like the lion to the deer.
This is the third Jātaka, the Story of the Trusting Food.
